knobs.label: Home end zone color
knobs.why: Paints the left end zone, where the football starts. The words on top stay white.

knobs.label: Away end zone color
knobs.why: Paints the right end zone, the GOAL the football is running toward.

knobs.label: Words in the goal
knobs.why: The word written sideways in the right end zone. Long words run off the edge, because the end zone does not grow.

knobs.label: Football size
knobs.why: How wide the ball is compared to the field. The 24 next to it means it never gets smaller than 24 pixels.

knobs.label: How high the ball bounces
knobs.why: How far the ball bobs up and down. You only see it while the timer is running, so press START.

knobs.label: Bounce speed
knobs.why: A bigger number makes the bounce slower. It is dividing the clock, so bigger means each bounce takes longer.

knobs.label: End zone width
knobs.why: How much of the field each end zone takes up. The playing field shrinks to make room.

knobs.label: Number of grass stripes
knobs.why: How many light and dark green stripes. Surprise: the yard lines do not move, because a different loop draws them.
